title: Which safety-relevant concepts are linearly representable and which are not?

original_idea.body: For ~8-10 safety concepts, extract a linear direction, measure linear separability plus an MLP-probe nonlinearity check, and produce a ranked linearity-score table across concepts and layers.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: a linearity audit tells where steering/probing safety tools silently fail.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Linear vs MLP probe across concepts/layers; building many contrast sets adds work.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable but breadth across many concepts adds some multi-workstream feel.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Foundational model-organism-flavored mapping labs have little incentive to publish; neglected.

novelty.reasoning: Linear representation hypothesis studied; a battery safety audit may be partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: A battery linearity audit across safety concepts may be open.
